raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Enables EAGLE3 (and other aux-hidden-state drafters) for Qwen3-MoE targets at PP > 1 on Model Runner V2. Same pattern as Qwen2 (#50514) and MiniMax-M3 (#57197); the Qwen3.5 counterpart is #61180.

## Claims

1. **Qwen3-MoE + EAGLE3 runs at PP > 1.** Base rejects it at load (`ValueError: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM does not support eagle3 with pipeline parallelism`). With this PR the last rank gets all taps in order; acceptance length (2.755 vs 2.753) and GSM8K match PP1.
2. **A tap on a PP stage boundary is recorded once.** The default taps `(2, 24, 45)` put one on the PP2 boundary of the 48-layer models.
3. **No change at PP = 1 or without aux layers**, except that a layer-0 tap is now cloned (see Details).

## Validation

**Setup:** 2x H200, `Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8` + `RedHatAI/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-speculator.eagle3` (`num_speculative_tokens=3`, default taps `(2, 24, 45)`), `main` at ab0e5ef795, Model Runner V2, default compile/CUDA graphs. The branch was then rebased onto 3c39dda2a5 (no upstream changes to the touched production files or the aux-relay helpers; #64111 split the shared fake layer, so the Qwen3 cases wrap it in a single-call `forward`); CPU tests and pre-commit were rerun there.

| Config | Starts | Mean AL | GSM8K (5-shot, 1319) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base, PP2 + EAGLE3 | `ValueError` on both ranks | – | – |
| PR, PP1, no spec | yes | – | 88.3 |
| PR, PP1 + EAGLE3 | yes | 2.753 | 88.2 |
| PR, PP2 + EAGLE3 | yes | 2.755 | 89.1 |
| PR, PP2 + EAGLE3, taps deliberately reordered (negative control) | yes | 1.020 | 89.2 |

GSM8K: `tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py` against `vllm serve` (completions, greedy, 1 run each; 1 SE ≈ 0.9 pt, all within ~1 SE). AL: `1 + accepted / drafts` from the server's spec-decode counters over the whole GSM8K run (~70k drafts). The negative control applies this PR and then swaps the upstream/local order on the last rank (`[45, 2, 24]` instead of `[2, 24, 45]`): AL collapses to 1.02 while accuracy is unchanged, since spec decode is lossless. So matching AL is the signal that the relayed taps are correct, and GSM8K shows output quality is unaffected.

<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8 --pipeline-parallel-size {1,2} \
  --max-model-len 4096 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"eagle3","model":"RedHatAI/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-speculator.eagle3","num_speculative_tokens":3}'
python tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py --port 8000
curl -s localhost:8000/metrics | grep -E '^vllm:spec_decode_num_(drafts|accepted_tokens)_total'
```
</details>

Offline `LLM.chat`, 16 prompts × 256 greedy tokens: AL 2.457 (PP1) vs 2.471 (PP2). Greedy outputs are not bit-identical between PP1 and PP2 even without spec decode (6/16 identical), so token equality is not used as a check here.

**CPU tests** (fakes, same style as the MiniMax-M3 cases in this file):
```bash
pytest -q tests/v1/worker/test_eagle3_aux_hidden_states_pp.py
# PR: 27 passed (includes 2 new opt-out cases for the VL/Omni subclasses)
# Production files reverted to base: 3 failed, 24 passed
#   test_qwen3_moe_pp2_preserves_ordered_global_aux_taps[taps0]  (0, 3, 6): boundary tap + layer 0
#   test_qwen3_moe_pp2_preserves_ordered_global_aux_taps[taps1]  (0, 1, 3): all taps upstream
#   test_qwen3_moe_pp1_output_and_aux_taps[taps1]                 layer-0 tap at PP = 1
#   (AssertionError: Tensor-likes are not close!)
```

**E2E test** (`tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/eagle/test_eagle3_pp.py`, new `test_qwen3_moe_eagle3_pipeline_parallel_acceptance`, 2x H200, same `_run` args as the Llama case plus a larger prompt set):
```bash
cd tests && pytest -v -s v1/e2e/spec_decode/eagle/test_eagle3_pp.py -k qwen3_moe
# PR:   1 passed (AL via _run: PP1 2.766, PP2 2.750 / 2.747 on two runs)
# Base: 1 failed
#   (Worker_PP0) ValueError: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM does not support eagle3 with pipeline parallelism
#   (Worker_PP1) ValueError: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM does not support eagle3 with pipeline parallelism
```

The Qwen3-MoE case uses `get_test_prompts(mm_enabled=False, num_prompts=64)` × 128 tokens instead of the Llama case's 4 prompts × 32 tokens. With the small set, PP2 acceptance varies run to run (1.707 and 1.764 on two identical runs) while PP1 is stable at 1.912, so PP2 fell below the 0.95 tolerance; on 64 GSM8K questions × 128 tokens the same config gave 2.345 vs 2.332. The threshold is unchanged.

```bash
pre-commit run --files $(git diff --name-only)   # all pass, incl. mypy
```

## Details

**Root cause.** `Qwen3MoeModel` had no #50514 opt-in, so MRV2 rejects aux-state drafters at PP > 1. Its `forward` already captured taps, but only stage-locally: a non-last rank dropped them from `IntermediateTensors`, the last rank never collected upstream taps, and every rank recorded its `start_layer` tap, so a boundary tap was taken twice (end of stage N-1 and start of stage N).

**Fix.** Set `supports_aux_hidden_states_over_pp` and follow `Qwen2Model.forward`: record the entry tap on the first rank only, `pack_local_aux_hidden_states` on non-last ranks, `collect_remote_aux_hidden_states` + local taps on the last rank. As in #57197, a layer-0 tap aliases `residual`, which fused add-RMSNorm may update in place, so it is cloned (any PP size; CPU-tested only, the GPU runs above use taps 2/24/45).

**Subclasses.** `Qwen3MoeLLMModel` in `qwen3_vl_moe.py` and `qwen3_omni_moe_thinker.py` override `forward` (deepstack) without the relay, so they set `supports_aux_hidden_states_over_pp = False` and keep today's startup error instead of inheriting the opt-in and silently dropping taps. Same approach as `MiMoModel` over `Qwen2Model`. Enabling them is a separate change.

**Size.** 3 production files, +24/−4. Tests: +109 CPU (fixture mirrors the MiniMax-M3 one), +42/−9 E2E (`_run` takes model/draft/prompts/lengths; Llama case unchanged).

**Limits.** Aux relay is MRV2-only. Validated EAGLE3 only; DFlash/DSpark on Qwen3-MoE at PP > 1 are now accepted but untested. Untested: Qwen3-235B-A22B, TP > 1 combined with PP, ROCm. Each PP hop carries one extra `[tokens, hidden]` tensor per upstream tap (not benchmarked). The new E2E test needs 2 GPUs and the 30 GB FP8 checkpoint at `gpu_memory_utilization=0.45` (run on H200; not tried on 80 GB cards), and takes ~2.5 min; the existing Llama case only runs where 4 GPUs are available, so maintainers may prefer a different CI placement. The CPU tests use `SimpleNamespace`/monkeypatch fakes like the existing MiniMax-M3 cases in the same file, which `tests/AGENTS.md` discourages; the E2E test is the real-object coverage. #57337 also edits `Qwen3MoeModel.forward` (possible conflict). No duplicate found (`gh pr list` / `gh issue list` for Qwen3-MoE + PP + EAGLE3/aux; #61180 covers Qwen3.5 only).

**AI assistance.** Claude Code wrote the code and tests, ran the H200 validation, and drafted this text. I reviewed every changed line and ran the commands above.

---

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

     torch.testing.assert_close(output, _pp_aux_state(_expected_aux_value(6)))
+
+
+class _PPAuxForwardLayer(_PPAuxLayer):
+    """Single-call forward like Qwen3MoeDecoderLayer."""
+
+    def __init__(self, index):
+        super().__init__(index, deferred=False)
+
+    def forward(self, positions, hidden_states, residual):
+        hidden_states, residual = self.forward_input_norm(hidden_states, residual)
+        return self.forward_after_input_norm(positions, hidden_states, residual)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def qwen3_moe_pp_stage(monkeypatch):
+    """Use the real Qwen3-MoE constructor/forward and aux helpers on CPU tensors."""
+    group = SimpleNamespace(world_size=2, is_first_rank=True, is_last_rank=False)
+    bounds = [0, 3]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qwen3_moe, "get_pp_group", lambda: group)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(parallel_state, "get_pp_group", lambda: group)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(parallel_state, "model_parallel_is_initialized", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        qwen3_moe, "VocabParallelEmbedding", lambda *args, **kwargs: torch.nn.Identity()
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qwen3_moe, "RMSNorm", lambda *args, **kwargs: _PPAuxNorm())
+
+    def make_layers(num_layers, build, prefix):
+        return (
+            *bounds,
+            torch.nn.ModuleList(
+                build(f"{prefix}.{index}")
+                if bounds[0] <= index < bounds[1]
+                else torch.nn.Identity()
+                for index in range(num_layers)
+            ),
+        )
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qwen3_moe, "make_layers", make_layers)
+
+    def make_stage(start, end, taps, world_size=2):
+        bounds[:] = [start, end]
+        group.world_size = world_size
+        group.is_first_rank = start == 0
+        group.is_last_rank = end == 6
+        config = SimpleNamespace(
+            vocab_size=16, hidden_size=6144, num_hidden_layers=6, rms_norm_eps=1e-6
+        )
+        model = qwen3_moe.Qwen3MoeModel(
+            vllm_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                model_config=SimpleNamespace(hf_text_config=config),
+                quant_config=None,
+                parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                    eplb_config=SimpleNamespace(num_redundant_experts=0)
+                ),
+                compilation_config=SimpleNamespace(mode=CompilationMode.NONE),
+            ),
+            decoder_layer_type=lambda **kwargs: _PPAuxForwardLayer(
+                int(kwargs["prefix"].rsplit(".", 1)[1])
+            ),
+        )
+        model._set_aux_hidden_state_layers(taps)
+        target = SimpleNamespace(
+            model=model,
+            make_empty_intermediate_tensors=model.make_empty_intermediate_tensors,
+        )
+        reserve_aux_intermediate_tensor_slots(target)
+        return model, target
+
+    return make_stage
+
+
+# (0, 3, 6) puts a tap on the stage boundary, which both stages could record.
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("taps", [(0, 3, 6), (0, 1, 3), (4, 5, 6)])
+def test_qwen3_moe_pp2_preserves_ordered_global_aux_taps(qwen3_moe_pp_stage, taps):
+    first, _ = qwen3_moe_pp_stage(0, 3, taps)
+    sent = first(None, None, None, _pp_aux_state(7))
+    last, target = qwen3_moe_pp_stage(3, 6, taps)
+    reserved = target.make_empty_intermediate_tensors(2, torch.float32, "cpu")
+    assert set(sent.tensors) == set(reserved.tensors)
+    result = last(None, None, sent)
+    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
+    output, aux = result
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output, _pp_aux_state(_expected_aux_value(6)))
+    for hidden, tap in zip(aux, taps, strict=True):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(hidden, _pp_aux_state(_expected_aux_value(tap)))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("taps", [(), (0, 3, 6)])
+def test_qwen3_moe_pp1_output_and_aux_taps(qwen3_moe_pp_stage, taps):
+    model, _ = qwen3_moe_pp_stage(0, 6, taps, world_size=1)
+    output = model(None, None, None, _pp_aux_state(7))
+    if taps:
+        output, aux = output
+        for hidden, tap in zip(aux, taps, strict=True):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(hidden, _pp_aux_state(_expected_aux_value(tap)))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output, _pp_aux_state(_expected_aux_value(6)))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("module_name", ["qwen3_vl_moe", "qwen3_omni_moe_thinker"])
+def test_qwen3_moe_multimodal_llm_does_not_inherit_pp_support(module_name):
+    module = importlib.import_module(f"vllm.model_executor.models.{module_name}")
+    inner = module.Qwen3MoeLLMModel.__new__(module.Qwen3MoeLLMModel)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="does not support eagle3"):
+        verify_supports_aux_hidden_states_over_pp(
+            SimpleNamespace(model=inner), "eagle3"
+        )
